script_text: Stop, Taurus, the Earth sign, the cosmos just flipped your emotional compass completely upside down right now! Mars is forming a harsh square to your ruling planet Venus, igniting a volatile storm in your 7th House of Partnerships. This intense celestial friction demands you confront hidden tensions within your closest relationships before they inevitably boil over into a public spectacle. If you are currently single, this transit aggressively repels casual flings and forces you to seek a profound, authentic connection; if you are taken, avoid withdrawing into cold silence. Meanwhile, Jupiter is aligning perfectly with your 10th House of Career, promising an unexpected professional promotion that requires bold, decisive action today. Beware of impulsive reactions during these highly tense moments, as your deep patience will transform this friction into an incredible financial blessing. Follow for tomorrow's daily reading to unlock the next phase of your cosmic destiny.
